verdict.rationale: Project-local skills are evidenced: a skill at `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md` creates `/deploy` (docs-33), and skills are defined as filesystem artifacts in their own directory (docs-64). User-global scope is only implied, by plugins being 'reusable across projects' and 'shared across projects and teams' (docs-7, docs-21). Missing for 10: an explicit user-global skills location (e.g. a home-directory skills folder), documented install-scope selection for plugins (user vs project), guidance on committing skills to the repo, and independent corroboration.
